subject.title: Renderer placeholder leak: `(see attached image)`, `Image reply`, `Audio reply`, `Media reply` leak to human-visible Telegram reply under specific content-classification paths

question: Which owner should oversee an instrumented current-main Telegram trace that records the shared reply payload and final Bot API request for the reported media-only reply path?
rationale: The identified literals serve legitimate prompt or transcript purposes, and changing them safely depends on proving where one becomes channel-visible rather than inferring the crossing from bundled output.

options.title: Trace Both Boundaries
options.body: Instrument the shared reply assembler and Telegram send boundary for the exact directive-plus-media path before approving a repair scope.

options.title: Trace Telegram Only
options.body: Capture only the final Telegram payload first, accepting that a second trace may be needed to locate the upstream substitution.

options.title: Wait For Reporter Artifact
options.body: Leave the issue pending until the reporter supplies a redacted raw outbound payload and correlated gateway logs.

recommendation.title: Trace Both Boundaries
recommendation.body: Instrument the shared reply assembler and Telegram send boundary for the exact directive-plus-media path before approving a repair scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram rendering history and the issue timeline make this the strongest available owner for the transport-side proof decision.
